theorems.name: Submission.lpf_raf_lla_disjoint_lipschitz_pieces
theorems.statement: ∀ (n Q : ℕ) (Ω D : Set (Eucl n)) (u : Eucl n → Eucl Q), IsOpen Ω → LocallyLipschitzOn Ω u → D ⊆ Ω → NullMeasurableSet D (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → ∃ (V B : ℕ → Set (Eucl n)) (K : ℕ → ℝ≥0), (∀ m, IsOpen (V m)) ∧ (∀ m, V m ⊆ Ω) ∧ (∀ m, LipschitzOnWith (K m) u (V m)) ∧ (∀ m, B m ⊆ D ∩ V m) ∧ Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint B) ∧ (∀ m, NullMeasurableSet (B m) (volume : Measure (Eucl n))) ∧ D ⊆ ⋃ m, B m
